string.text: Anti-radiation drug

The drug of radioprotective action "Mexamine", widely distributed in the territory of the Zone. When applied, it causes narrowing of peripheral blood vessels and oxygen starvation, which in this case is a means of preventing and treating radiation sickness. It is well tolerated by the vast majority of people. In some cases, mild nausea, dizziness, pain, and less often vomiting are possible.

Anabiotic

An experimental drug developed for scientific research groups operating in the Zone. Tetradotoxin, known as "zombie powder," which is part of the drug's formula, causes complete paralysis of the central nervous system. Presumably, this can ensure survival outside the shelter during the release. After six years of field testing, most prudent stalkers now keep a couple of them with them in case of sudden releases.

Psy-block

A narcotic drug that blocks avalanche-like nerve impulses. An interesting side effect is that after taking the drug, there is a short-term disappearance of any emotions. It is used in the Zone to counteract anomalous fields of increased psy activity. I have not found any use outside of it. It has a long-lasting effect. Taking 2 tablets each.

Antidote

The drug "Antitoxicant IP2" is a complex of antidotes: metoclopramide, pyridoxine, thiamine, riboxin and others. It introduces substances into the blood that can decompose protein poisons, as well as absorbents of synthetic poisons. It is not particularly popular, since most stalkers rely more on a gas mask and overalls. Nevertheless, there are still those stalkers who have several hidden packages of this drug in case of an emergency. It has a long-lasting effect. Take 1 capsule.

Radioprotectant

The Indralin-B190 Radioprotectant was part of the personal first-aid kits of the NPP workers. It appeared in the Zone as a substitute for the excessively toxic cystamine hydrochloride (PC1). Reduces the effect of gamma radiation on the tissues of a living organism. It is advisable to use this drug preemptively, that is, before irradiation, since it does not have an instant effect. It has a long-lasting effect. Take 1 capsule.

Diclofenac sodium

A nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) from the group of phenylacetic acid derivatives. The mechanism of action of the drug is to dull nervous activity. Due to the huge number of side effects, such as headache, dizziness, drowsiness, in some cases - memory disorders, disorientation, irritability - it is not used for medicinal purposes in most countries of the world. However, it has gained popularity in the Zone due to a side effect expressed in a violation of the sensitivity of the central nervous system, which allows it to withstand severe injuries such as bullet and shrapnel wounds.

A tool created in the conditions of the Zone, which makes it possible to accelerate the recovery of the body by accelerating metabolism. It is popular among stalkers, as it helps to improve well-being due to the weak effect of anesthesia and is the most affordable, albeit weak, regenerative drug. It is rumored that an unknown group of chemical stalkers was able to synthesize it from the bodies of mutants. Anyway, the active ingredient of this remedy allows you to speed up recovery, even though it is toxic.

Despite the very outdated tissue regeneration product, this kit still continues to be popular due to its accessibility. It won't do much to help in battle, but it's great to heal wounds in a calm environment. The main active ingredients in this kit cause a large accumulation of toxins in the body, so you should not use it often.

Improvised stimulators (stimpacks) are very popular among novice stalkers because they are easy to get, and they are relatively inexpensive. They are made from ingredients widely available in the Area without proper cleaning and without the use of special equipment, which leads to severe intoxication and dizziness during use. Thanks to the huge doses of the regenerative drug, the wounds heal right before our eyes. And the painkiller in the composition will allow you to continue the fight despite the injuries. Due to the strong acceleration of metabolism, a huge amount of nutrients is consumed, which greatly increases hunger.

Military stimpack

Military stimulators (stimpacks) are part of the standard military equipment for operations in the Exclusion Zone. But this is on paper - ordinary military personnel are rarely lucky enough to receive stimpacks to help. They are quite common on the goods market and can be bought for a reasonable price. They are popular among experienced stalkers, as they are significantly more powerful and faster-acting than their affordable homemade counterparts, which makes them ideal for use in dangerous situations. Despite the production in good conditions and the modified composition, this drug still remains sufficiently toxic and causes side effects, including hunger. It is intended for the treatment of various kinds of injuries and wounds in dangerous situations, as well as pain relief. It allows wounded soldiers to quickly get back on their feet and continue to conduct active combat operations.

A small package of Alprazolam in 0.25 mg tablets. This drug is well known among chemists and pharmacists for its properties that help in the treatment and prevention of panic disorders, depression and anxiety disorders. An indispensable tool for stalkers who decide to explore dangerous territories, such as the Yantar plant, Radar and the Red Forest, or simply go to secret laboratories. Side effects include severe drowsiness after application. For this reason, some stalkers prefer to take simple caffeine pills with them. It is best to drink water.

Cocaine

Small aluminum case containing cocaine doses and injection tools. Cocaine is a powerful stimulant of the nervous system. Its effect lasts from 15-30 minutes to an hour, depending on the injection site. Cocaine increases alertness, a sense of well-being and euphoria, increases energy and long-term activity, a sense of competence and sexuality. Physical strength can be increased in sports where long-term attention and endurance are required. Anxiety, paranoia, and restlessness are also common symptoms of its use. With excessive dosage, concussions, convulsions and increased body temperature are observed. Bandits often snort this drug immediately before storming bases and camps.

Epinephrine shot

Epinephrine (also known as adrenaline) is a hormone combined with a neurotransmitter. Epinephrine performs many functions in the body: it instantly regulates the heart rate, dilates blood vessels, making it easier for air to pass through them, and also causes metabolic shifts. Adrenaline is released during fight or flight from the sympathetic nervous system. The effects lead to an increase in blood glucose and fatty acids, thereby providing the body with instant substrates for energy production inside cells throughout the body.

In clinical medicine, morphine is considered the gold standard of opioid analgesics, used to relieve severe and excruciating pain. As with other opioids such as oxycodone, hydromorphone, and diacetylmorphine (heroin), morphine acts directly on the central nervous system to relieve and reduce feelings of pain. Injected into the arm or thigh.

Sulfadimethoxine

A long-acting sulfonamide drug. It is effective against Gram-positive and gram-negative bacteria: it acts on pneumococci, streptococci, staphylococci, E. coli, Klebsiella bacillus (Friedlander's bacillus), pathogens of dysentery; less active against proteus; active against trachoma virus (an infectious eye disease that can lead to blindness); does not act on strains of bacteria resistant to other sulfonamide preparations. Possible headaches, dyspeptic disorders (digestive disorders), skin rashes, drug fever (a sharp increase in body temperature when taking the drug), leukopenia (a decrease in the level of white blood cells in the blood).

Film-coated tablets. A tablet of the drug contains 4.6 and 10 mg of perphenazine. The drug is an antipsychotic neuroleptic that has antiallergic, sedative, muscle relaxant, antiemetic, weak anticholinergic, hypotensive and hypothermic effects. The effectiveness of Etperazine is due to the blockade of D2 receptors of the mesocortical and mesolimbic systems. It is used in the Zone as a cheap analogue of an antidote.

This drug was developed somewhere in the laboratories of the Zone and acts as a powerful stimulant that triggers rapid tissue regeneration and greatly dulls pain. Tetanus vaccine

The tetanus vaccine is an inactivated tetanus toxin that will help prevent infection. Tetanus, known as "Jaw trismus," is a disease caused by bacteria from the Clostridia family that enter the body through open wounds, forming the poison tetanospasmin. It is a potentially fatal disease because the poison affects the nervous system, blocking nerve signals from the spinal cord to the muscles. All animals of the Exclusion Zone and mutants are carriers of Clostridium bacteria, which can be transmitted to stalkers through bites. The tetanus vaccine can boost the protection of your immune system without having side effects. In addition, it contains additional antitoxins that expand the purpose of this vaccine in addition to treating tetanus.
